name: Saudi Awwal Bank
summary: Established in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in 1978, Saudi Awwal Bank is a leading financial institution that delivers a broad spectrum of banking and financial solutions throughout the Kingdom. The bank strategically manages its operations across several key divisions, including Retail Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, and Treasury, along with other supporting segments. For individual clients, its extensive offerings feature various account types, such as current, savings, and commodity investment options; diverse personal and home financing solutions, including loans secured by cash deposits; a comprehensive range of credit, debit, and prepaid cards; and in-depth wealth management services. These wealth services cover asset management, brokerage, securities, investment banking advisory, debt capital markets, project and export finance, equity research, and Takaful (Islamic insurance) services. Additionally, it provides efficient payments and transfer capabilities, exclusive private banking, secure safe deposit lockers, and convenient digital banking access via online, mobile, and telephone channels. Businesses can access deposit accounts, a variety of credit facilities, and specialized business credit cards. The bank also offers advanced liquidity and cash management services, encompassing collection, payment, and point-of-sale solutions. Its trade and receivables finance capabilities include import/export services, guarantees, and tailored structured trade solutions. Investment banking advisory, derivatives trading, repurchase agreements, and Sharia-compliant financial products are also fundamental components of its corporate services. Beyond its core banking activities, Saudi Awwal Bank functions as an insurance agent and engages in the purchasing, selling, and leasing of land and real estate properties. The bank serves its clientele across Saudi Arabia through an extensive network of 108 branches.
